name: Take Five 5/4 walk
desc: Five-beat walking vamp in Eb minor, Take Five feel: 3+2 long tones in sparse, five-quarter walk in full, eighth-note skips and double-time bar-ends at peak.

root.doc: semitone offset from Eb minor home

code.full: note("<[eb2 bb1 gb2 eb2 bb1] [bb1 f2 db2 bb1 ab1] [eb2 bb1 gb2 eb2 db2] [ab1 eb2 b1 ab1 bb1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.25).slow(16)).lpq(2).shape(${drive}).attack(.006).decay(.18).sustain(.32).release(.12).clip(.88).gain(${gain}).room(.25).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[eb2 bb1 [gb2 ab2] eb2 bb1] [bb1 f2 db2 [bb1 db2] ab1] [eb2 bb1 gb2 [eb2 f2] db2] [ab1 eb2 b1 ab1 [bb1 db2]]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.85, ${cut}*1.5).slow(8)).lpq(3).shape(${drive}).attack(.005).decay(.16).sustain(.3).release(.1).clip(.86).gain(${gain}).room(.22).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(3).play()
